en.title: The Star Chart of the Indigo Night and the Lingering Scent of the Terminus
en.premise: Mio, a girl who runs a late-night cafe, meets a young man named Saku one evening. He carries an ancient star chart that depicts the trajectories of stars that should no longer exist in the modern sky. Amidst the bitterness of coffee and the scent of the night after a rain, the two trace the memories of a lost night, maintaining a delicate distance—close enough to touch, yet never quite overlapping. This is a story of two wavering hearts and the premonition of farewell heralded by the final train.

zh.title: 蓝夜的星图与终点的余香
zh.premise: 在深夜经营咖啡店的少女澪，在某个夜晚遇见了携带古旧星图的青年朔。他所指出的星图，描绘着在如今的天空中本不该存在的、往昔星辰的轨迹。在咖啡的苦味与雨后夜晚的气息中，两人保持着若即若离的距离，一同追寻失落的夜晚记忆。这是一个在末班车预示的离别预感中，描绘两人摇曳心境的故事。

prediction_results.question: 朔が残した星図の謎と、彼が再訪した夜に起こることは？
